text.tspan: I'm a senior software engineer with 7+ years of experience building full-stack products, distributed
backend services, and AI systems. My center of gravity is the platform layer: event-driven services, data
pipelines, and the retrieval and evaluation infrastructure that makes LLM-powered products dependable.
I own work from design review through production: shaping the architecture, instrumenting it, and staying
accountable for how it behaves under real traffic. Today I focus on AI governance tooling, systems that
help teams decide whether content is original, fair, and safe.
